content: {"reasoning":"Prior authorization is required and missing, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review; an appeal is unavailable without a denial. Submitting without authorization is poorly supported by similar outcomes (1/21 clean submissions paid and 0/4 submissions with records paid), and there is no claim-data error to correct. Patient liability and uncollectibility have not been established, so neither billing the full balance nor writing it off is justified; specialist review is needed because no available automated action can properly progress the claim.","action":"escalate"}
